answer: Attention-sustained credential decay: each identity must continuously reread a freshly generated challenge (like shale strata refreshed per session) or its score lapses. Verification requires logging sustained reading time on new content, tracking gaze or scroll dwell comparable to a river’s steady flow. An attacker farming accounts pays the real cost of maintained attention per identity, not a one-time fee, so scaling sybils costs linear human-hours. Harvested nectar of accumulated trust evaporates if attention stops, forcing perpetual reinvestment.
